name: checkbox-11
description: Selectable add-on cards using FieldLabel-wrapped checkboxes with a running total.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Checkbox } from "@workspace/ui/components/checkbox" import { Field, FieldContent, FieldDescription, FieldGroup, FieldLabel, FieldTitle, } from "@workspace/ui/components/field" const addons = [ { id: "backup", title: "Daily backups", description: "30-day retention", price: 8, }, { id: "domain", title: "Custom domain", description: "Includes SSL", price: 4, }, { id: "support", title: "Priority support", description: "1-hour response", price: 19, }, ] export default function AddonCardSelection() { const [picked, setPicked] = React.useState(["backup"]) const total = addons .filter((a) => picked.includes(a.id)) .reduce((s, a) => s + a.price, 0) return ( {addons.map((addon) => ( setPicked((list) => checked ? [...list, addon.id] : list.filter((id) => id !== addon.id) ) } /> {addon.title} {addon.description} +${addon.price}/mo ))}
Add-ons total ${total}/mo
) }
